# Ken Suya

> Nigerian suya specialist in Birmingham, UK. Beef, chicken and lamb suya hand-rolled in signature yaji spice and grilled fresh to order. Order via WhatsApp or Instagram for collection or delivery — no app or account needed.

Ken Suya is a Birmingham-based Nigerian/West African street food business specialising in suya — thin-sliced, spice-crusted meat skewers grilled over an open flame. All yaji spice (roasted peanut, ginger, garlic, cayenne) is roasted and ground in-house.

## Ordering

- Orders are placed via WhatsApp (+47 7863 337662) or Instagram DM (@KenSuya) — there is no online checkout or app.
- Both collection and delivery are available across Birmingham.
- Ordering hours: Tue–Thu 16:00–21:00, Fri–Sat 12:00–23:00, Sun 13:00–20:00. Closed Monday.

## Menu

- Beef Suya — £8.00 — the signature dish, thin-sliced beef hand-rolled in yaji and grilled over open flame.
- Lamb Suya — £9.00 — tender lamb, double-dusted in yaji, char-grilled.
- Chicken Suya — £7.50 — juicy chicken thigh grilled hot, finished with onion and tomato.
- Party Platters — from £45.00 — mixed suya for guests, beef/chicken/lamb.
- Extra-Spicy Special — £8.50 — extra yaji and extra heat.

## Location

Unit 4, Greenfield Business Park, Birmingham, B11 2AA, UK. Collection and delivery only — no dine-in seating.
